artworks.title: Plate 61: Blue Crow(?), Jackdaw, Chickadee or Tit, and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts a tree with gnarled branches and sparse leaves positioned in the center. Three birds are perched on the tree, while two more birds are on the ground in the foreground. The color palette consists of earthy tones with pops of blue and black. Text is inscribed above and below the image.

artworks.title: Plate 62: Northern Bald Ibis and Glossy Ibis with Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various birds in a natural setting. The image features a collection of birds gathered in a circular frame. There are seven birds illustrated within this circle, each one situated on or near rocky terrain or tree branches. The birds vary in size and color. The ground is grassy with some elevation, leading to a rock where one of the dark birds perches. A tree branch extends into the scene, adorned with green leaves and what appear to be blue-black berries. The surrounding background is neutral, keeping the focus on the birds and their environment.

artworks.title: Plate 63: Six Small Birds, Including a Bluethroat and a Cuckoo(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of birds perched on and around a gnarled tree. The painting features a collection of six birds, each distinct in its coloration and form, situated on a barren landscape where the earth appears rugged and eroded. The birds are distributed across the scene, with some perched on the twisted branches of a leafless tree, while others are stationed on the ground or near a body of water below a cliff. The artwork is rendered with fine detail, capturing the feathers and postures of the birds intricately. Latin text is inscribed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Plate 64: Two Partridges, a Wren, and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of birds in a natural setting with various fruits. The painting features several birds, each of a different species, perched on a branch or standing on the ground, surrounded by a variety of fruits. The composition is enclosed in an oval shape, with Latin text at the top and the Roman numeral LXIV on the side. The birds are finely detailed, with each individual bird labeled with a number. The background is lightly colored, emphasizing the vivid colors and textures of the birds and fruit.

artworks.title: Plate 65: Thrushes and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Four birds of various species are shown on a tree branch with foliage. The birds have different colors, and the foliage includes shades of green and yellow. One bird is on a tree trunk, while the others are on the ground. A black bird is on the left next to a tree branch, while a brown bird and grey-brown bird are near a bush with dark berries on the right. The image is set against a light background.

artworks.title: Plate 66: Doves and Pigeons
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts four pigeons and a small branch with leaves and berries, all set against a plain background within a circular frame. The pigeons exhibit varying shades of grey, blue, and brown with detailed feather textures. A creamy-colored pigeon is perched on a branch extending from the left, adorned with green leaves and orange berries. Below, another pigeon stands on a bare tree branch that stretches across the center. The two remaining pigeons rest on the tiles of a roof in the lower part of the composition. The roof is depicted in warm terracotta tones, providing a complementary contrast to the pigeons' plumage.

artworks.title: Plate 67: Two Doves beneath a Gourd and Apples
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two birds are perched on a slender branch across the lower part of a central oval, with their bodies facing right. One bird is dark blue and green, while the other is beige. Above them, a larger branch arches across the top, bearing two red apples and a yellow, striped gourd hanging to the right. The color palette features natural browns of the branches, vibrant red and green of the apples, yellow of the gourd, and varied bird plumage colors, against a white background. The apples occupy the upper left of center, and the gourd hangs in the upper right. In the middle left of the frame, there is a small bird perched on the branch just below the apples.

artworks.title: Plate 68: A Ptarmigan, Swallows, and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: A group of birds, predominantly swallows, are perched on the bare branches of a tree. Some birds are on the ground. The color palette is brown, grey, black, and white with subtle reddish accents on some birds. There is a small bird on the top left, a pair of birds in the center, and another bird on the right branch. Two larger birds are on the ground, with one bird facing left and bending down slightly.

artworks.title: Plate 6: Four Birds of Prey, Including a Sparrowhawk(?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts four birds in an oval frame. One large dark brown bird is perched on a branch on the left side, a medium-sized grayish-blue bird stands on a stump, a slightly smaller brown bird nearby, and another bird with a red and yellow crest on its head sits on a wooden post. The color palette consists mainly of earthy tones - brown, gray, blue, and green in the grass, with colorful touches in the crested bird's headpiece. The birds are placed from left to right, with grass and stalk-like plants surrounding them.

artworks.title: Plate 69: Black Woodpecker, European Green Woodpecker, Nuthatch, and Other Birds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features various birds in different positions. The central object is a black bird with a red crest on mossy tree roots. There are other birds surrounding it, showcasing a variety of colors such as black, brown, red, blue, gray, and green.

artworks.title: Plate 70: Empty Oval
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: In the image, a single continuous line forms an elliptical shape against a plain background. The abstract form resembles an outline of an egg or an oval. The composition focuses on the curvature of the line and its symmetry. On the right side, there is a marking of Roman numerals, "LXV".

artworks.title: Plate 72: Empty Oval
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts a single, continuous, thin line forming an oval shape on a plain background. In the bottom right corner, the Roman numeral "LXXI" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Plate 7: Four Birds of Prey on a Wooden Frame
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of four birds perched on a wooden stand. The painting depicts the birds with varying plumages, sitting on the wooden structure in a grassy area with some foliage. To the left of the birds, there is a flowering plant with thin green leaves and red flowers. The birds are illustrated in great detail, with distinct markings and textures on their feathers, showcasing realistic coloration and intricate features. Each bird is numbered above its head. The style might imply that the artist was influenced by traditional bird studies common in earlier botanical and zoological illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 8: Bearded Vulture with Two Birds of Prey
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds perched on branches. The painting features three distinct birds, each resting on separate branches within a circular frame. The birds exhibit varying colors and postures. The bird at the bottom left has a reddish-brown body with a black head and wings, while the bird in the middle has a brown body and white accents on its head and wings. The bird at the top right is darker in color. The branches they stand on are barren. Surrounding the central image is Latin text in a classical font.

artworks.title: Head of an Old Man (recto)
artworks.medium: red chalk, with touches of black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of an elderly man in profile, turned to the left. He has a sharp facial profile with a long beard. His hair is unkempt. He wears a textured cloak draped over his shoulders. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface with some loose lines.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper; laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (diameter): 22.8 x 17.8 cm (9 x 7 in.)
artworks.creditLine: John Davis Hatch Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man showing his upper body from just below the shoulders. The man is facing slightly to his right, with his face turned towards the viewer. He has curly dark hair, a prominent nose, and defined cheekbones. His expression is neutral. He is wearing a high-collared shirt or cravat and a dark coat with the collar turned up. There is a signed name at the bottom left of the drawing. The background is plain and neutral-toned, emphasizing the subject within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Apollo Standing in a River Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene featuring a nude figure holding a draped cloth. In the background, there is a cityscape with domed and spired buildings, and an arched bridge. The sky has textured clouds, while the trees on the left and right are finely detailed. The color palette is warm and mainly sepia tones. Another figure on horseback is also visible, adding scale and narrative to the scene.

artworks.title: The Centaur Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: overall: 11 x 7.3 cm (4 5/16 x 2 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection

artworks.title: A Sacrifice to Pan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures gathered in an outdoor setting with mythical and allegorical elements. The figures are depicted with dynamic poses and gestures. The use of reddish-brown ink accentuates the lines and curves of the bodies and fabrics. On the left, figures are engaged in action or interaction, while the right side shows two figures near a pedestal or drum. The flowing drapery and idealized form of the figures contribute to a classical or baroque style. The drawing suggests themes of mythology, allegory, or religious narrative.

artworks.title: Studies for Judith and Holofernes, David and Goliath, The Finding of Moses, and Others [recto]
artworks.medium:
a) pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
b) pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures and scenes sketched in brown ink on paper. The drawing displays a collection of human figures in various poses, composed in a manner that appears to be somewhat chaotic and spontaneous. The style is reminiscent of preparatory sketches, with loose and flowing lines capturing the dynamic postures of the figures. In the upper section, some figures appear to be reclining or gathered, possibly engaged in an interaction or conversation, while others seem to be caught in motion. Scattered around the page are additional figures that appear to be standing or walking, identified with suggestions of cloaked garments. There are also hints of architectural forms and possibly natural elements, like hills or rocks implied by the curves and shading. The presence of handwritten notations or text fragments adds to the chaotic and detailed nature of the work. The overlapping sections and partial renderings of figures give the drawing an unfinished, exploratory quality, typical of sketches meant to capture a burst of ideas.

artworks.title: Studies for the Raising of Lazarus and Other Compositions [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image shows several sketches and handwritten notes on a paper. The sketches feature human figures in different poses and activities. The handwritten notes, possibly in Italian, accompany the illustrations in cursive handwriting. The figures are rough and incomplete, typical of artistic studies or drafts.

artworks.title: Village along a River Estuary in Devon
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a broad expanse. The horizon is low in the composition above buildings and ship masts on the distant shore. The sky occupies most of the upper portion of the painting. Buildings with red-tile roofs and whitewashed walls line the shore, with ships' masts rising above them. The brushstrokes indicate a watercolor technique, giving a soft texture to the scene. The color palette is earthy with browns, greens, and grays. Cattle are resting on dark sand or soil in the foreground. Hills are visible in the distance with buildings reflecting in the water.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy with a Triumphal Bridge
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective drawing of a large bridge with a rider on horseback statue atop it. The drawing emphasizes the detailed architecture of the bridge and the statue. Parts of the bridge's structure are highlighted with fine, controlled lines and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving the drawing a historical feel. Figures and stone sculptures are seen close to the viewer, adding scale and liveliness to the scene. Background arches draw the eye into the distance, while the sky is lightly sketched to keep the focus on the bridge.

artworks.title: Gaiety and Grief
artworks.medium: red chalk with touches of black chalk on laid paper, laid down, with border lines drawn by the artist
artworks.dimensions:
overall (sheet): 12.7 x 7.9 cm (5 x 3 1/8 in.)
image (to border line): 10.8 x 6.3 cm (4 1/4 x 2 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The first figure is standing, holding a staff with a banner that reads "L'Allegresse." They are wearing a draped garment, with one shoulder exposed. The figure has short, curly hair adorned with leaves or small flowers. The second figure is seated at the feet of the standing figure, with a hand on their head. The background shows rocky formations, sparse vegetation, and a textured ground.
